batches.baseline: The 294-item queue released five November 27 feed items and had only four full future UTC days through December 1. Current authenticated Pinterest impressions, saves and outbound clicks were unavailable; retained October 11–November 10 reference data has one to five outbound clicks per Pin with unknown publication ages.
batches.hypothesis: Eight original scene-led compositions varying botanical paths, cozy tabletop worlds and layered miniatures, paired with seven specific useful tool cards, can extend the release buffer and may earn saves and actual outbound visits. Compare matching reporting windows and publication ages after public availability.
batches.timeCost: Approximately 90 minutes of generation, source and full-size/phone review, copy, queue, checks and release; monetary labor and tool charges unavailable.
batches.reviewCheckpoint: 2026-12-12 or at least seven days after each Pin is observed publicly available, whichever is later
